summary: v43 timetable repair-pass + substitute backend tests — 12/12 new pytest tests pass + 24/24 prior v40+v41 regression all pass (36/36 total). Verified: (1) /suggest-batch reaches 0 unfilled with 4-teacher setup over 5 subjects × 5 days × 5 teaching periods × 4 sections; (2) every section returns repair_stats={attempts, swap_repairs, substitute_repairs}; (3) substitute repairs produce slots with is_substitute=true AND non-empty teacher_id; (4) swap repairs produce swapped_from={day, period}; (5) ZERO teacher double-bookings across the full batch (verified by walking all (day, period, teacher_id) tuples); (6) /save-batch persists unfilled rows (teacher_id='' with a subject_id) — verified via GET /api/timetable; (7) GET /api/timetable/coverage returns {sections_with_unfilled, total_unfilled, details[]} = 0/0/[] after fully-repaired save, and >0 with details list when cap=1 forces unfillable; (8) POST /substitute-suggest returns items with {teacher_id, teacher_name, teaches_subject, daily_load, on_leave_today}, teachers who teach prefer_subject_id rank FIRST, and busy teachers at (day, period) are excluded; (9) /substitute-apply persists is_substitute=true on existing unfilled slot and returns {ok:true, slot_id}; (10) /substitute-apply returns HTTP 409 with conflict_with={class_id, section, subject_id} when chosen teacher is double-booked.

minor.issue: defaults.lunch_break_period validator is ge=1 — there is no way to omit lunch entirely from the schedule. Workaround used in tests: put lunch on the last period (e.g. periods_per_day=6, lunch_break_period=6) so 5 teaching periods × 5 days = 25/section. Consider allowing 0/None to mean 'no lunch'.

When notify=true and the teacher has no telegram_chat_id, the queue_notification side-effect is wrapped in try/except Exception: pass — silent. Logging at WARN would help debugging non-delivery. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Allow lunch_break_period=0 or null to mean 'no lunch break' in SuggestBatchDefaults — currently ge=1 forces callers to consume a period for lunch even when they don't want one.

(Optional, repeat from v41) /app/backend/routes/timetable.py is now 1840 lines — past the 700-line guideline. Strong refactor candidate: split into timetable_suggest.py / timetable_save.py / timetable_publish.py / timetable_coverage.py / timetable_substitute.py.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/timetable.py grew from 1488 → 1840 lines with v43. Strongly recommend modularizing per route group.

Repair pass (lines ~808-920): intra-section swap then cross-subject substitute. Correctly updates `busy` set and `teacher_day_load` after every swap/sub, preventing internal double-booking. swap_done short-circuits via 'break' to avoid double-fixing. Good.

/coverage (lines 1641-1658): correctly aggregates rows where teacher_id IN ('', None). Uses tenant_db. Allows both school_admin and teacher roles — teacher access is reasonable for awareness but consider whether teachers should see the coverage of OTHER sections.
/substitute-apply 409 logic (line 1749-1763): uses $nor over (class_id, section) — correctly excludes the SAME slot being applied to, so a re-apply of substitute on the SAME slot won't 409. Good.

/substitute-suggest (line 1715): teaches_subject is derived from `t.subjects` list which is stored in ROOT users collection. If a school admin later edits subjects via PATCH /api/users/{id}, the suggestion will reflect that — verified working in tests via Anita seed/patch path.

save-batch (line 1392): inserted_total only counts FILLED rows; this is intentional per the problem statement but the response field name 'inserted' is misleading — consider renaming to 'inserted_filled' OR returning both 'inserted_filled' and 'inserted_unfilled' counts so the UI can show 'persisted 76 filled + 24 empty slots'. Non-blocking.

Repair pass uses allowed_periods constraints during swap candidate filtering (line 863-870) — good. However it does NOT re-check max_consecutive_heavy or subject_categories='heavy' during the swap, so a swap could create a 3-in-a-row heavy block when max_consecutive_heavy=2. Edge case; not tested in v43 but worth noting for hardening.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_v43_timetable_substitute.py is canonical v43 regression. The school's saved timetable is rewritten across tests (reset_existing=True + delete_many in save-batch). To reach 100 teaching slots with the existing validators, use periods_per_day=6 + lunch_break_period=6 (lunch on last period → 5 teaching periods × 5 days × 4 sections = 100). To deterministically force unfilled rows in repair scenarios, set max_periods_per_day_per_teacher=1 (the cap is tight enough that 4 teachers × 1 period/day < 5 needed daily slots/section even after the substitute pass). The 409 conflict scenario for substitute-apply requires finding an unfilled slot at the SAME (day, period) as a filled slot in a different section — under cap=1, this naturally exists because the engine picks at most one teacher per (day, period) across all sections.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. v43 features (repair pass, persisted unfilled rows, /coverage, /substitute-suggest, /substitute-apply) all work to spec. Initial test failures were due to my test using lunch_break_period=0 (validator requires >=1); fixed by moving lunch to last period.
